title: I'm building a dark ARPG that runs in the browser, solo, with AI tools
author: Merlindovich
selftext:
This is Bathed in Blood, an action RPG in the spirit of the classics that you play in a browser tab, on PC or phone, with mouse, gamepad or touch.

There are three classes (Warrior, Ranger, Sorceress) and five zones to climb through, each with its own monsters, mini-bosses and look. At the top of every zone theres a unique boss fight. At the end the Bloodbath, a 100 level survival arena. Along the way there's loot with affixes, a talent tree, blacksmith and random map events.

I build it alone past 10 weeks, with many ai tools, details on the site and in my dev diary on my channel. Lately most of my time has gone into making it feel good: spells built against reference footage, fire that casts flickering shadows, environment like rain and fog that moves around the hero, camera shake and hit-stop on big blows, and lighting that keeps monsters readable in the dark.

 It's free to play, no install: [https://bathedinblood.com](https://bathedinblood.com)

Happy to talk about the workflow, including what the AI was good at and where it needed a lot of steering. Honest feedback on the game itself is very welcome too.  
  
Comments are very welcome, good or bad, and the most useful ones come from people who've played a bit first. I only ask that we keep it civil. If AI-made games aren't your thing, that's completely fair, and you don't need to comment.
